notes: cics-crucible condition-handling / hc-map-not-in-mapset (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): SEND MAP / RECEIVE MAP for a map its mapset does not hold (MAPSET omitted, so it is the MAP name): abend ABM0, no condition, a HANDLE ABEND exit takes it. Scenarios restate the crucible's terminal steps; the oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs.

scenarios.name: in-mapset
scenarios.why: SEND MAP('HCM3') MAPSET('HCSET3'): the map is in its mapset, the screen is sent

scenarios.name: omitted-mapset
scenarios.why: SEND MAP('HCSET3') with no MAPSET: map HCSET3 is not in mapset HCSET3 (its map is HCM3), ABM0

scenarios.name: receive
scenarios.why: RECEIVE MAP('HCSET3') with no MAPSET: the same, ABM0

scenarios.name: exit
scenarios.why: HANDLE ABEND LABEL, then SEND MAP('HCNONE') MAPSET('HCSET3'): ABM0 goes to the exit, which logs ASSIGN ABCODE

scenarios.name: unmatched-mode
scenarios.why: takes the EVALUATE arm no crucible scenario reaches: a mode no WHEN names (falls through)
